import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,shutil
h=pathlib.Path('docs/baselines/v2-phase-e/final-gate');sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(h/'validation-38.json')=='c603f3ad578eb464869b69a831263311c2919be597f913475b9008b8e2e9f081'
l=json.loads((h/'validation-38.json').read_text());assert l['exit_code']==0 and hashlib.sha256(l['stdin'].encode()).hexdigest()==l['stdin_sha256']
s=json.loads((h/'validation-results.json').read_text());m=json.loads((h/'measurements.json').read_text())
actual_setup=sum(len(f['setup'][role]) for f in m['fixtures'] for role in ['baseline','candidate'])
assert actual_setup==s['recorded_setup_commands']==12
print('Actual recorded setup command count from measurements:',actual_setup)
assert sha(h/'REPORT.md')=='749bc69f78f7fba312dff23c66c805de8f4db15ad301dca10af2bff5427d2ff3'
assert sha(h/'validation-results.json')=='37648c3720b04de624cd31b9788fd1a06fc374a5e6351624d12c015a62ba80b2'
for name,expected in s['generated_artifacts_sha256'].items():assert sha(h/name)==expected
pre=json.loads(json.loads((h/'validation-22.json').read_text())['stdout'])
for p,expected in pre['immutable_files_sha256'].items():assert sha(pathlib.Path(p))==expected,p
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--check','--','/dev/null',str(h/'validation-38.json')],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode in [0,1] and not r.stdout and not r.stderr
print('Companion38 SHA/stdin/exit and new-file diff checked after generation; no self-hash cycle. Report/manifest/generated evidence and all345 immutable files unchanged.')
print('HEAD:',subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip())
print('Changed paths:');subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],check=True)
